cases.title: Power reaches more people
cases.subtitle: Global electricity access · 2010–2023
cases.visual_concept: A rising line chart linked to small household and light illustrations; chart marks remain primary and exact.
cases.takeaway: Global electricity access rose from 83.5% to 91.6% between 2010 and 2023.
cases.data_source: World Bank WDI EG.ELC.ACCS.ZS; API snapshot retrieved 2026-10-14
cases.must_preserve: The line rises through all four exact year-value pairs. Use a 0–100% scale and do not imply universal access.

cases.title: Where 100 kg of food goes
cases.subtitle: Illustrative weekly household flow
cases.visual_concept: A left-to-right illustrated flow of groceries through purchase, storage, and preparation, ending with food kept; flow widths and loss marks reflect the exact quantities.
cases.takeaway: Half remains; preparation is the largest single loss.
cases.data_source: Synthetic controlled example; illustrative only, not measured data
cases.must_preserve: The flow balances 100 − 12 − 18 − 20 = 50 kg. Losses move downward; preparation is the largest loss.

cases.title: Three ways to get to work
cases.subtitle: Illustrative weekday commute
cases.visual_concept: Three distinct, large transport illustrations—rail train, bus, bicycle—each paired with one share mark and one travel-time mark. Keep the two measures visually distinct and aligned by mode.
cases.takeaway: Rail has the largest share; cycling is fastest.
cases.data_source: Synthetic controlled example; illustrative city, not a real survey
cases.must_preserve: Keep mode, share, and minutes paired correctly. Rail has the largest share; Bike has the shortest time.

cases.title: A $100,000 solar project
cases.subtitle: Illustrative community budget
cases.visual_concept: Four connected geometric areas sized by budget share, with a bold simple pictogram integrated into each area: solar panels, installation tools, battery, and a small training group. Let shape area and pictograms carry the story.
cases.takeaway: Panels receive the largest share; training receives the smallest.
cases.data_source: Synthetic controlled example; illustrative project budget
cases.must_preserve: Rectangle areas follow 45:25:20:10. Attach each exact amount to the matching category.
